نمتطي (form VIII)
# نَمْتَطِي (namtaṭī) /nam.ta.tˤiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
# نَمْتَطِيَ (namtaṭiya) /nam.ta.tˤi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
